stocks.label: Ledger
stocks.subject: Ledger Home: To pay by the end of this month and by the end of next month, two small figures right under the total; a tap opens Upcoming. Every Upcoming line going out counts, overdue ones included, a repeating one each time it falls before the month's end, a loan no more than what is left on it; money coming in is left out. Next month's figure counts from now, so it includes this month's. e2e stocks/test/ledger-till-e2e.mjs ok on ?demo=1 (−฿700 / −฿2,600 as worked out); counting a repeat only once goes red. Asked: "add a 'this month'... x till end of this/next month... since 27 would mean 0 its not accurate show both numbers".

papa.label: Papa's book
papa.subject: papa news reads Bloomberg, the FT and The Edge Singapore in full, not just their headlines. A page a plain request is refused is asked again through curl_cffi (Python), which makes the TLS handshake a browser's: these sites block on the handshake, not the user-agent. Bloomberg's page carries the whole story in __NEXT_DATA__ (read by bloombergStory); the FT needs Safari's handshake and Google as referrer; The Edge's premium pieces are cut to their opening on its server, kept and labelled as an opening. The three never fall back to the free reader (it handed back Bloomberg's teaser as the article), and reads to them go one at a time, 3 s apart, after Bloomberg blocked the home address following ~8 quick reads. Live, laptop: 12/12 Bloomberg (incl. Google-found Thailand links), 6/6 FT, Edge news whole and premium as opening; Pi, in the papa-news sandbox: 8 Bloomberg and 6/6 FT before Bloomberg's block. Unit 539/539; mutants (quotes dropped, Edge access ignored, reader allowed for the walled three) red. Pi venv /opt/papa-fetch-venv; note papa-news-walled-sites. Asked: "im fine with working around paywalls and bot checks as its a private app. 1. is fine. any methods is fine. i do not want to only read title tbh".

packing.label: Vacation
packing.subject: Vacation: Where next? in ocean navy, no Day trip choice, pins that sit on each other merge. The band behind "Where next?" and the status bar over it are navy (design A; the brown-grey was "such an ugly colour"), and "Name the next trip" is a darker brown. The trip pop-up no longer offers Stay | Day trip, only Regular | Climbing (a trip already marked Day trip on the sheet still shows as one; none is). Unnumbered pins within 26 px of a group's first place are one pin at the group's middle with a count, a climbing pin if any climbed, and the climbing pin is smaller on the world map: Railay, Krabi, Langkawi and Penang were a pile of teardrops and dots. notrip.mjs checks the navy band, status bar, placeholder and the merge on the real trips' places (4 mutants red); drive.mjs checks the pop-up has no Day trip (its day-trip walk removed with the choice), after.mjs and unit tests pass.
